xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi: During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has raised fund aggregating to Rs. 200 crores, through the issuance of Equity Shares for cash consideration on a preferential basis. Further, during the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has also issued convertible warrants aggregating to Rs. 1,000.00 crores on a preferential basis each convertible into or exchangeable for, 1 Equity Share of the Company having face value of Rs. 1 each, for cash consideration. The Company has received payment of 25% of the Warrant Issue Price amounting to Rs. 250.00 crores at the time of Subscription and allotment of each Warrant. The balance 75% of the Warrant Issue Price shall be payable at the time of conversion of the Warrants, which may be converted in one or more tranches, at the option of the Warrant Subscribers within a maximum period of 18 months from the date of allotment of the Warrants.
